<div class="review-text">
A fantastic expansion to the base game which delivers exactly on the exceptional level of quality I've come to expect from Mobius Digital. There is a great deal of new content and story to explore and engage with, and the creativity poured into the new environments, characters, and puzzles is overwhelming. My heart was warmed deeply by this opportunity to return to the Outer Wild's universe and I highly recommend it for everybody who enjoyed the base game.
